scope: Lượt 22 / Bước 85–88 — read-only consumer bridge for Diagnostic; no mastery, Priority Engine or runtime activation

reasonCodes.BLUEPRINT_NOT_EXECUTABLE: Syllabus metadata may seed a later diagnostic but is not an executable question bank.
reasonCodes.DYNAMIC_INSTANCE_REQUIRED: A dynamic Bauman subject must be instantiated from its real syllabus before diagnostic use.
reasonCodes.LEGACY_SIDECARS_MISSING: Required additive formula, exercise, simulation and test sidecars are incomplete.
reasonCodes.LEGACY_MAPPING_UNVERIFIED: The legacy lesson has no verified semantic Roadmap target.
reasonCodes.FRAMEWORK_OUTLINE_ONLY: The theory-framework item is a secondary outline and is not physical lesson content.
reasonCodes.MASTERY_STORE_ABSENT: No versioned mastery/evidence store exists before Lượt 24.
reasonCodes.PRIORITY_ENGINE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Priority Engine implementation begins only after Diagnostic and mastery contracts pass.
reasonCodes.PRODUCTION_DISCONNECTED: The Roadmap V2 package is intentionally disconnected from production entrypoints.

rules: Physical legacy identity remains authoritative and immutable.
A verified exact mapping grants reference visibility only; it never grants diagnostic, mastery, Priority Engine or runtime eligibility.
Unmapped legacy lessons and all framework outline candidates remain quarantined.
Roadmap chapter and lesson contracts are blueprints, not claims that learning content or assessments already exist.
Every consumer result carries explicit eligibility and reason codes.

abortConditions: consumer or upstream manifest hash mismatch
unknown eligibility state or mapping status
any Priority Engine eligible legacy record before the dedicated integration gate
any production entrypoint reference to roadmap_v2 before runtime integration
